steps.title: Load CSV and Set Parameters
steps.instruction: Upload the formatted .csv file and specify all protocol parameters: destination plate type (96 or 384‑well), mastermix source type (12‑channel NEST 15 mL reservoir or Greiner Bio‑One 96‑well 200 µL plate), mastermix plate slot, mastermix volume per column (µL), starting column, DNA volume (µL), transfer scheme (multi‑dispense or single‑dispense), and P20‑multi GEN2 mount (left or right).

steps.title: Place Labware on Deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck so that the chosen destination plate occupies its designated slot, the mastermix source occupies the specified slot, and fill every empty slot with tip‑rack plates; the robot will prompt for tip‑rack refill if they run out.

steps.title: Load Mastermix into Source
steps.instruction: If using the NEST reservoir, fill only the first channel with mastermix; if using the 96‑well plate, fill the first columns (starting at the specified column) with the user‑specified mastermix volume per column.

steps.title: Transfer Mastermix per CSV Row
steps.instruction: For each row in the CSV, aspirate the defined mastermix volume from the current source well/column and dispense it into the destination well indicated (Sarstedt 384‑well plate). The robot will automatically advance to the next source column when the current one is depleted, according to the selected transfer scheme.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate mastermix from current source well
If source well empty, robot moves to next column automatically

steps.title: Monitor Tip Usage
steps.instruction: Watch for tip‑rack depletion; when prompted, refill the tip racks before the protocol continues.
